items.title: `vilan fmt` writes a long CALL inside an element-body hole badly - kolt prefs.vl:276-282, `{select_component("sidebar_collapsed", ListCell::of([("Shown", false), ("Hidden", true)]), …).styled(const button_style(…) + css { … })}`: the first line runs far past the budget, the SECOND `` is split across three lines while its twin stays inline (the two tuples of one list printed unalike), and the `.styled(..)` chain link continues on the call's closing line; the wanted output breaks the call's ARGUMENTS one per line, the list's tuples one per line with each element literal whole, and the chain link on its own line
items.discussion: the owner's ask (2026-10-12/13): "improve the formatted output of prefs.vl:276-282"; the formatter (vilan-core formatter.rs: `print_element` -> `print_element_inline` / `print_element_split` ~7373-7422, `print_split_chain` ~6986 with E137's one-link width door, `LINE_BUDGET`, the call-argument and list-literal breaking); element-syntax.md (the paper's formatting section for markup and holes); E181 (fmt's `export *;` placement - the last fmt item of this class); the fmt corpus (`vilan/test` goldens) and `fmt_declines`; kolt is fmt-clean, so the quoted lines ARE today's output
